description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) Ellen White Mentions all of the time in her writings that we should flee the cities to reside in the countryside. My question is what if you aren't in the position to purchase a home? What will happen if you are stuck in the cities? I know God will help with the earnest prayer and faith but as a young married couple with 3 small children, no formal education and a system that makes it harder and harder to buy a home, it is starting to get a little worrisome. None of my family members have a country home either so staying with someone when trouble hits is not in the picture at the moment.
.
2.) My question is if God is not about money then why do we go to work and pay him tithes?
.
3.) The sexual desires of men. How can one overcome such a sin that is so deeply intertwined with our carnal nature to lust after another woman while being married?
.
.
